name: util-twilio-wait_for_caller
description: Call this when the other party says they are logging in, reviewing, checking something or looking something up, and will take a moment. It says a short line such as "Sure, take your time." to them and then waits quietly until they speak again. Call it with no other text: do not say anything before or after it. Do not call it for voicemail, or when the other party has already answered what you asked.
